sum: AGM Group Holdings Inc., a technology company, research, development, manufacture, assembly, and sale of technology hardware in China, Hong Kong, and Singapore. It also engages in the sale of cryptocurrency mining machines and standardized computing equipment; blockchain-oriented ASIC chip design; development and provision of software; and provision of financial technology software and core technology services. AGM Group Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
ceo: Dr. Bo  Zhu (CEO, Chief Strategy Officer & Director)
